Scratches · Panel refinishing · Paint assessment

Paint repairs begin with assessing the affected finish and the condition of the panel underneath. Tell us whether you’re addressing accident damage, a scratch or a larger cosmetic project.

The scope of preparation and refinishing depends on the condition of the vehicle. Ask us about the areas included in your estimate, the expected finish and aftercare before authorizing the work.

Your privacy

When you call or email the shop, your contact details and any photos are used to respond to your repair inquiry. An online request form, when available, also shares those details with the form provider and the shop. Do not send payment details, identification documents or unnecessary personal information.

Google Maps and Instagram have their own privacy policies. This site does not use advertising analytics. For questions about information sent to the shop, contact somicoachworks@gmail.com.
